description: A juvenile Peplos: 3 body regions (B3), a head, 2 eyes, two antennae, 6 legs, 4 flaps; skin; splayed, neck head. It is the type of its kind, a moth or butterfly: patterned flaps; fliers of the flowers. Coat: colour marigold; translucency between; flap markings plain; second colour butter. Shape: hind body between. Proportions: a small body, the head carried low, big eyes, long antennae, short legs, fine legs, narrow feet, a thin waist, a dipping back, wide flaps, a slim build.
